from scipy.stats import ttest_ind

# Extract the wealth data for white males in 1990 and 1996
wealth_1990_males = white_males['composite_wealth_1990']
wealth_1996_males = white_males['composite_wealth_1996']

# Extract the wealth data for white females in 1990 and 1996
wealth_1990_females = white_females['composite_wealth_1990']
wealth_1996_females = white_females['composite_wealth_1996']

# Perform t-tests to check for significant differences in wealth between 1990 and 1996 for white males
t_stat_males, p_value_males = ttest_ind(wealth_1990_males, wealth_1996_males)

# Perform t-tests to check for significant differences in wealth between 1990 and 1996 for white females
